notes:
POC objective: validate Dedicated capacity for latency-sensitive trading/notification pipelines and customer support chat + re-ranking workloads. High-level summary:
- Capacity ask: baseline sizing request = 8x H100 (reserved pool) with autoscale headroom of +4 GPUs for burst; exploring alternate config with 16x A100S for cost comparison.
- Performance targets: 95p tail-latency < 200ms for chat (avg 150 tokens), median < 60ms for embeddings queries; sustained throughput target = 600 requests/sec for embeddings reranker flows, 120 concurrent chat sessions peak.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate-to-high — looking to justify reserved commit vs. burstable Dedicated. Target blended per-token cost to be <= current internal infra by 15%.
- Test plan executed so far:
  * 2026-02-18 kickoff call (ff_20260218_orpheus_poc_call) — initial topology, PD, auth/SSO requirements.

  * 2026-03-06 long soak started (planned 48h). Current status: 30h completed — seeing slow drift in 95p latency during peak (spike associated with KV-cache flushes).
- Observations / technical notes:

  * Batching strategy: continuous batching reduced CPU overhead but increased per-request 95p; testing smaller batch window to reduce tail.
  * Routing consideration: prefer routing chat to lower-latency model variant with slightly lower opt quality for SLA-critical endpoints; fall back to higher-quality variant for non-critical flows.
  * Networking: VPC peering and private NLB required; customer legal wants clause about data residency in colocation region.
